github_git_ref.object.url: The API URL for the git object associated with the reference.
github_git_ref.url: The API URL of the Git reference, as returned by the GitHub API.

github_git_tag.node_id: The GraphQL Node ID of the git tag.
github_git_tag.sha: The SHA-1 hash of the git tag object, which serves as its unique identifier.
github_git_tag.verification: The verification object for the Git tag, containing details such as whether the tag is verified, the reason for verification, the signature, and the signed payload.
github_git_tag.verification.payload: The payload of the tag verification, i.e., the signed content that was verified against the signature.
github_git_tag.verification.reason: Indicates the reason for the tag verification status, such as 'valid_signature', 'unsigned', 'invalid_signature', 'expired_key', or 'unknown_key'.
github_git_tag.verification.signature: The GPG or SSH signature generated by the signing key, used to verify the authenticity and integrity of the tag.
github_git_tag.verification.verified: Whether the tag's signature is verified.
github_git_tag.verification.verified_at: The timestamp indicating when the tag's signature verification was performed.

github_git_tree.sha: The SHA-1 hash of the tree object, assigned by GitHub when the tree is created.
github_git_tree.tree.content: The content of the file (blob) represented by this tree entry. This field is typically populated only for blob entries, often when the tree is fetched recursively and the file is small enough to include inline.
github_git_tree.tree.mode: The file mode for the tree entry. Valid values are 100644 (regular file), 100755 (executable file), 040000 (subdirectory), 160000 (submodule/gitlink), and 120000 (symbolic link).
github_git_tree.tree.path: The file path relative to the repository root for the tree entry.
github_git_tree.tree.sha: The SHA-1 hash of the git object (blob or tree) referenced by this tree entry.
github_git_tree.tree.type: The type of the tree entry, which is one of 'blob' (file), 'tree' (subdirectory), or 'commit' (submodule).
github_git_tree.truncated: Whether the tree is truncated due to GitHub's limits (e.g., too many entries).
github_git_tree.url: The GitHub API URL for this tree.

github_gpg_key.can_certify: Indicates whether the GPG key has the certify capability, i.e., can be used to certify other keys.
github_gpg_key.can_encrypt_comms: Indicates whether the GPG key can be used to encrypt communications.
github_gpg_key.can_encrypt_storage: Indicates whether the GPG key can be used to encrypt storage. This computed value reflects the key's encryption capability for data at rest.
github_gpg_key.can_sign: A boolean indicating whether the GPG key can be used for signing.
github_gpg_key.created_at: The date and time when the GPG key was created, in ISO 8601 format. This value is set automatically by GitHub.
github_gpg_key.emails: A list of email objects associated with the GPG key, each representing an email address bound to the key.
github_gpg_key.emails.email: The email address associated with the GPG key.
github_gpg_key.emails.verified: Indicates whether the email address associated with the GPG key is verified on the GitHub account.
github_gpg_key.expires_at: The date and time when the GPG key expires, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). This field is computed by GitHub and may be null if the key does not expire.
github_gpg_key.key_id: The GPG key ID as returned by the GitHub API.
github_gpg_key.primary_key_id: The unique identifier for the primary key associated with this GPG key.
github_gpg_key.public_key: The ASCII-armored public key content for the GPG key.
github_gpg_key.raw_key: The raw GPG key data, typically the full ASCII-armored public key block for the GPG key.
github_gpg_key.revoked: True if the GPG key has been revoked.
github_gpg_key.subkeys: A list of subkeys associated with the GPG key, each containing its own key details (e.g., key ID, raw key, and associated emails).
github_gpg_key.subkeys.can_certify: Whether this GPG subkey can be used for certification (i.e., signing other keys).
github_gpg_key.subkeys.can_encrypt_comms: Whether this GPG subkey can be used for encrypting communications.
github_gpg_key.subkeys.can_encrypt_storage: Whether this subkey has the encryption capability, specifically for encrypting storage.
github_gpg_key.subkeys.can_sign: Whether this subkey can be used for cryptographic signing.
github_gpg_key.subkeys.created_at: The timestamp of when the GPG subkey was created, in ISO 8601 format.
github_gpg_key.subkeys.emails.email: Email address associated with the GPG subkey.
github_gpg_key.subkeys.emails.verified: Boolean indicating whether the email address associated with the GPG key subkey is verified.
github_gpg_key.subkeys.expires_at: The date and time when this GPG subkey expires, in ISO 8601 format, or null if it never expires.
github_gpg_key.subkeys.key_id: The unique identifier for this GPG subkey.
github_gpg_key.subkeys.primary_key_id: The numeric ID of the primary GPG key that this subkey belongs to.
github_gpg_key.subkeys.public_key: The public key data for this GPG subkey.
github_gpg_key.subkeys.raw_key: The raw GPG public key data for this subkey, typically the unarmored key content as opposed to the ASCII-armored public_key.
github_gpg_key.subkeys.revoked: Whether the GPG subkey has been revoked.
github_gpg_key.subkeys.subkeys: A list of subkeys associated with this GPG key. Each subkey is an object that includes its own key ID, public key, and permission flags for signing, encryption, and certification.

github_hook.config.insecure_ssl: Controls whether GitHub disables SSL verification when delivering webhook payloads. Accepts '0' or false to enable verification, and '1' or true to allow insecure connections (e.g., self-signed certificates).
github_hook.created_at: The timestamp indicating when the webhook was created, in ISO 8601 format.
github_hook.deliveries_url: The URL to the API endpoint for listing deliveries of this webhook.
github_hook.last_response: The last response received from the webhook's target URL, providing status and message from the most recent delivery.
github_hook.last_response.code: The HTTP response code received from the last webhook delivery.
github_hook.last_response.message: A string describing the response status of the last webhook delivery.
github_hook.last_response.status: The status of the most recent delivery for this webhook, indicating whether it succeeded or failed.
github_hook.ping_url: The URL to ping the webhook to trigger a test event, as provided by the GitHub API.
github_hook.test_url: The URL used to test the GitHub webhook by sending a test payload.
github_hook.type: The type of the hook, which is always 'Repository' for a repository-level hook.
github_hook.updated_at: The timestamp indicating when the GitHub hook was last updated.
github_hook.url: The URL of the webhook in the GitHub API.

github_issue.active_lock_reason: The reason the issue is locked, if applicable. Possible values are `off-topic`, `too heated`, `resolved`, and `spam`.
github_issue.body_html: The HTML-rendered version of the issue body.
github_issue.body_text: The plain-text version of the issue body, with Markdown removed.
github_issue.closed_at: The timestamp when the issue was closed, in RFC3339 format (e.g., 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z).
github_issue.closed_by.avatar_url: The URL of the avatar image for the user who closed the issue.
github_issue.closed_by.email: The email address of the user who closed the issue. This is only present if the user has a public email associated with their GitHub account; otherwise it is null.
github_issue.closed_by.events_url: The URL to fetch the events associated with the user who closed the issue. This is a standard GitHub API user attribute, providing a link to the user's public events.
github_issue.closed_by.followers_url: The URL to the followers list of the user who closed the issue.
github_issue.closed_by.following_url: The URL to retrieve the list of users that this user follows. This is a template URL that can include the placeholder {/other_user} to check if a specific user is followed.
github_issue.closed_by.gists_url: The URL to access the gists of the user who closed the issue, via the GitHub API.
github_issue.closed_by.gravatar_id: The unique Gravatar ID for the user, used to generate avatar image URLs.
github_issue.closed_by.html_url: The HTML URL of the GitHub profile for the user who closed the issue.
github_issue.closed_by.id: The unique numeric identifier of the user who closed the issue.
github_issue.closed_by.login: The username of the user who closed the issue.
github_issue.closed_by.name: The display name of the user who closed the issue, as provided by the user's GitHub profile. This field is optional and may be absent if the user has not set a name.
github_issue.closed_by.node_id: The GraphQL node ID of the user who closed the issue.
github_issue.closed_by.organizations_url: The URL to the GitHub API endpoint listing the organizations that this user belongs to.
github_issue.closed_by.received_events_url: The URL to the user's received events feed, for the user who closed the issue.
github_issue.closed_by.repos_url: URL to the GitHub API endpoint listing the repositories owned by the user who closed the issue.
github_issue.closed_by.site_admin: Indicates whether the user is a GitHub site administrator.
github_issue.closed_by.starred_url: The URL template for the user's starred repositories, with placeholders for {owner} and {repo} parameters.
github_issue.closed_by.subscriptions_url: The URL to view the subscriptions of the user who closed the issue. This field is part of the user object returned in the `closed_by` field of an issue.
github_issue.closed_by.type: The type of GitHub account that closed the issue, such as 'User' or 'Bot'.
github_issue.closed_by.url: The REST API URL for the user who closed the issue.
github_issue.closed_by.user_view_type: Indicates the user's profile visibility type, either 'public' or 'private'. In the context of the user who closed the issue.
github_issue.comments: The number of comments on the GitHub issue. This value is computed and provided by GitHub.
github_issue.comments_url: The API endpoint URL that returns the comments for this issue.
github_issue.created_at: The creation timestamp of the GitHub issue, set by the provider and returned as a string in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2023-01-01T12:00:00Z).
github_issue.draft: A boolean indicating whether the issue is a draft. Draft issues are hidden from non-collaborators and are not ready for review.
github_issue.events_url: The URL to retrieve the events associated with this issue, such as labeling, closing, or reopening.
github_issue.html_url: The URL to view the issue on GitHub's website.
github_issue.issue_dependencies_summary.blocked_by: The number of issues that are blocking this issue, i.e., the count of dependencies that must be resolved before this issue can be completed.
github_issue.issue_dependencies_summary.blocking: The number of issues whose implementation is blocked by this issue, based on declared issue dependencies.
github_issue.issue_dependencies_summary.total_blocked: The total number of issues that this issue is blocked by.
github_issue.issue_field_values.field_id: The unique identifier of the project field that this value is associated with.
github_issue.issue_field_values.value: The value assigned to the custom issue field. The type is dynamic and depends on the custom field's definition (e.g., text, number, date, or selection).
github_issue.labels_url: The API endpoint URL for querying the labels of this issue.
github_issue.locked: Indicates whether the issue is locked for comments, meaning only users with write access can comment.
github_issue.milestone: The milestone associated with the issue, if any. This field is computed and read-only; it cannot be set from the client.
github_issue.node_id: The Node ID of the issue, used by GitHub's GraphQL API.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.client_id: The client ID of the GitHub App that performed the action.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.created_at: The ISO 8601 timestamp of when the GitHub App was created.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.description: The description of the GitHub App that performed the action.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.external_url: The URL of the GitHub App's homepage or external reference site.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.html_url: The URL to the GitHub App's public page on GitHub.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.node_id: The GraphQL global node ID for the issue, usable as an identifier in GraphQL queries.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner: The user or organization that owns the GitHub app.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.avatar_ur: The URL of the avatar image for the owner (user or organization) of the GitHub App that performed the action.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.created_a: The timestamp (as a string in ISO 8601 format) of when the GitHub App owner account was created.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.descripti: The description of the organization that owns the GitHub App. This field is only populated when the owner is an organization.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.events_ur: The URL to the events for this GitHub user or organization.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.followers: The URL to the list of followers of the owner (user or organization) of the GitHub App that performed the issue.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.following: The URL template for the list of users this owner is following, with a placeholder for the username (e.g., https://api.github.com/users/{username}/following).
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.gists_url: The URL to fetch the owner's public gists, following the standard GitHub API URL format for user gists.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.gravatar_: The Gravatar ID of the GitHub App owner, used to construct the owner's avatar URL from Gravatar.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.html_url: The URL to the GitHub profile of the app owner.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.id: The unique numeric identifier of the user or organization that owns the GitHub App.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.login: The GitHub username of the owner of the GitHub App that performed the action.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.name: The display name of the user or organization that owns the GitHub App.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.node_id: The GraphQL node ID of the user or organization that owns the GitHub App.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.organizat: The URL to retrieve the list of organizations associated with this GitHub App owner, as defined by the GitHub API.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.received_: The URL to the user's received events endpoint on GitHub, containing the user's incoming events.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.repos_url: The URL to the list of repositories belonging to this owner (user or organization).
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.site_admi: Indicates whether the owner is a site administrator for the GitHub instance (e.g., on GitHub Enterprise).
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.slug: The slug of the owner of the GitHub App that performed the action on the issue. For users and organizations, this is the lowercased, URL-friendly identifier (e.g., 'octocat').
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.starred_u: The URL to the list of repositories starred by this owner (user or organization) of the GitHub App.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.subscript: The API endpoint URL for the owner's subscriptions, indicating resources the owner follows or is subscribed to on GitHub.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.type: The type of GitHub account that owns the app, either `User` or `Organization`.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.url: The API URL for the GitHub account (user or organization) that owns the GitHub App.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.user_view: The user's profile view type, either 'public' or 'private'.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.owner.website_u: The website URL of the user or organization that owns the GitHub App which performed the action on the issue.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.permissions.che: The permission level for the Checks API. Set to 'read' or 'write' to grant the GitHub App access.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.permissions.con: The permission level granted to the GitHub App for accessing repository contents.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.permissions.dep: The permission level for deployments granted to the GitHub App. Allowed values are 'read', 'write', or 'none'.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.permissions.iss: The permission level for issues granted to the GitHub App that performed the issue.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.permissions.met: The permission level for metadata access granted to the GitHub App, typically 'read' or 'write'.
github_issue.performed_via_github_app.updated_at: The timestamp of when the GitHub App was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

github_issue.pinned_comment.body_text: The plain-text body of the pinned comment, with any Markdown or HTML formatting removed.
github_issue.pinned_comment.created_at: The timestamp indicating when the pinned comment was created.
github_issue.pinned_comment.html_url: The URL to view the pinned comment on the GitHub website.

github_issue.pinned_comment.pin.pinned_by.organizatio: The URL to the organizations list for the user who pinned the comment.
github_issue.pinned_comment.pin.pinned_by.received_ev: The URL to retrieve events received by the user who pinned the comment.
github_issue.pinned_comment.pin.pinned_by.repos_url: The URL to the list of repositories owned by the user who pinned the comment.
github_issue.pinned_comment.pin.pinned_by.site_admin: Whether the user who pinned the comment is a GitHub site administrator.

github_issue.pinned_comment.pin.pinned_by.url: The URL of the GitHub user who pinned the comment.

github_issue.pinned_comment.user.followers_url: The API URL to list the followers of this user.

github_issue.pinned_comment.user.html_url: The URL to the user's GitHub profile.

github_issue.pinned_comment.user.name: The display name of the user, if provided.
github_issue.pinned_comment.user.node_id: The GraphQL node identifier of the user who authored the pinned comment.
github_issue.pinned_comment.user.organizations_url: The API URL to list the organizations that this user belongs to.
github_issue.pinned_comment.user.received_events_url: The URL to retrieve the list of events received by this user, per the GitHub API.

github_issue.repository.teams_url: The URL to the teams endpoint for this repository.

github_issue.repository.updated_at: The timestamp of the last update to the repository, in ISO 8601 format.

github_pull_request.merged_by.email: The email address of the user who merged the pull request, if publicly available.

github_pull_request.merged_by.site_admin: Whether the user is a GitHub site administrator.
github_pull_request.merged_by.starred_url: The URL template for the user's starred repositories. It is used to construct the API endpoint to list the repositories starred by this user.
github_pull_request.merged_by.subscriptions_url: URL to the GitHub API endpoint listing repositories that this user is subscribed to.
github_pull_request.merged_by.type: The type of GitHub account that merged the pull request.
github_pull_request.merged_by.url: The URL for the user who merged the pull request.
github_pull_request.milestone.closed_at: The timestamp of when the milestone was closed, in ISO 8601 format.
github_pull_request.milestone.closed_issues: The number of issues associated with this milestone that are currently closed.

github_pull_request.milestone.creator.login: The GitHub username of the user who created the milestone.
github_pull_request.milestone.creator.name: The display name of the user who created the milestone, if provided.
github_pull_request.milestone.creator.node_id: The GraphQL node ID of the user who created the milestone.
github_pull_request.milestone.creator.organizations_url: The URL to the user's organizations endpoint, which lists the organizations the user belongs to.
github_pull_request.milestone.creator.received_events_url: The URL to the received events for the user who created the milestone.
github_pull_request.milestone.creator.repos_url: URL to the endpoint listing the user's repositories, as defined by the GitHub API.
github_pull_request.milestone.creator.site_admin: Whether the user is a GitHub site administrator.

github_pull_request.milestone.description: The description of the milestone associated with the pull request.
github_pull_request.milestone.due_on: The due date of the milestone, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). This field is required, so it always has a value.
github_pull_request.milestone.html_url: The URL to view the milestone on GitHub.
github_pull_request.milestone.labels_url: The URL for the labels endpoint of this milestone, which lists the labels associated with it.
github_pull_request.milestone.node_id: The node ID of the milestone in the GitHub GraphQL API.
github_pull_request.milestone.open_issues: The number of open issues associated with this milestone.
github_pull_request.milestone.updated_at: The timestamp of the last modification to the milestone associated with the pull request.
github_pull_request.milestone.url: The API URL for the milestone.
github_pull_request.node_id: The GraphQL node ID for the pull request, used to identify the resource in the GitHub GraphQL API.
github_pull_request.patch_url: The URL to the patch file for this pull request.
github_pull_request.rebaseable: Whether the pull request can be rebased.
github_pull_request.requested_reviewers: List of users and/or teams that have been requested to review the pull request.

github_pull_request.requested_reviewers.login: The GitHub username of the requested reviewer.

github_pull_request.requested_reviewers.organizations_url: The URL to access the list of organizations that the requested reviewer belongs to.

github_pull_request.requested_reviewers.site_admin: Indicates whether the requested reviewer is a GitHub site administrator.
github_pull_request.requested_reviewers.starred_url: The URL template to list repositories starred by the user, with placeholders for owner and repo. Typically in the form https://api.github.com/user/starred{/owner}{/repo}.
github_pull_request.requested_reviewers.subscriptions_url: The API URL to the user's subscriptions endpoint, which lists the repositories the user is subscribed to.

github_pull_request.requested_reviewers.url: The API URL for the requested reviewer (user or team) on the pull request.

github_pull_request.requested_teams.html_url: The URL to the team's page on GitHub.
github_pull_request.requested_teams.id: The unique identifier assigned to the team in GitHub.

github_pull_request.requested_teams.members_url: URL to retrieve the members of this team, with a placeholder for a specific member.

github_pull_request.requested_teams.node_id: The GraphQL node ID of the team.

github_pull_request.requested_teams.organization_id: The unique identifier of the organization that owns the team requested for review on this pull request.

github_pull_request.review_comments_url: The API endpoint URL for the list of review comments on this pull request.
github_pull_request.stack.base: The pull request's base branch section, containing details such as the branch name, commit SHA, and repository information.
github_pull_request.statuses_url: The API URL to query the commit statuses associated with the pull request's head commit.
github_pull_request.updated_at: The timestamp of the last update to the pull request, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2025-04-01T12:34:56Z).
github_pull_request.url: The API URL of the pull request, e.g., `https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{number}`.
github_pull_request.user.avatar_url: The URL of the user's avatar image.
github_pull_request.user.email: The email address of the GitHub user, if publicly available.
github_pull_request.user.events_url: The URL to the events of the GitHub user, typically in the form https://api.github.com/users/{username}/events{/privacy}.
github_pull_request.user.followers_url: The API endpoint URL to retrieve the list of followers of this user.
github_pull_request.user.following_url: The URL endpoint that retrieves the list of users that this user is following.

github_pull_request.user.html_url: The URL to the user's GitHub profile page.

github_pull_request.user.login: The GitHub username of the user associated with the pull request.
github_pull_request.user.name: The full name of the user as provided on their GitHub profile. This field is optional and may be null if the user has not set a name.
github_pull_request.user.node_id: The node ID for the user, which is a global identifier used with GitHub's GraphQL API.
github_pull_request.user.organizations_url: URL to the list of organizations this user is a member of, as provided by the GitHub API (typically https://api.github.com/users/{username}/orgs).
github_pull_request.user.received_events_url: The URL to the GitHub API endpoint that lists events received by the user.
github_pull_request.user.repos_url: The URL to the GitHub API endpoint listing the user's repositories.
github_pull_request.user.site_admin: Indicates whether the user is a GitHub site administrator.
github_pull_request.user.starred_url: The URL to the list of repositories starred by the user.
github_pull_request.user.subscriptions_url: The URL to retrieve the subscriptions of the user via the GitHub API.
github_pull_request.user.type: The type of GitHub account, typically 'User' or 'Organization'.
github_pull_request.user.url: The API URL for the GitHub user, e.g., https://api.github.com/users/{username}.
